newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Lepanto plans American Depositary Receipts.
newsitem.headline: Lepanto plans American Depositary Receipts.

text.p: Lepanto Consolidated Mining Co said on Tuesday it was planning to issue American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange, Lepanto Mining said the Bank of New York Co Inc will act as the depository bank. It did not say how much the issue would be worth.
Company officials were not available to provide further details.
Brokers attributed the rise in Lepanto shares on the Philippine Stock Exchange on Tuesday to talks that it will establish an ADR programme.
Lepanto A shares surged 12.66 percent, or ten centavos, closing at 89 centavos while its B shares ended ten centavos up, or 10.64 percent, at 1.04 pesos.
The A share was the most actively traded issue for the day with total volume at 267,030 shares valued at 242 million pesos.
Other Philippine companies with ADR programmes include Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co, Benguet Corp and First Philippine Holdings Corp.
